source.name: Permanent Service for Mean Sea Level (PSMSL), RLR monthly means

method: Each dot is the point answer for its spot (/api/trend for sea level at the dot), from the gauge's monthly mean sea level: each month minus that calendar month's 1995–2014 average (the fitted seasonal cycle where the record has no such average), then the Mann-Kendall test and Sen's slope over the whole record from start to end (sparse early years left out, as the point answer does), with the 95% range widened for months that are alike. Rates are relative to the land at the gauge, in mm a year, unrounded (the point answer's slope_per_decade, ci_low and ci_high over 10): round them as the card rounds headline_rate (2 significant figures, half away from zero). A dot whose record the point answer would not use, or whose spot is answered by another gauge, is in skipped. A skipped PSMSL dot whose spot is answered by another gauge carries psmsl_mode when /api/trend with source=psmsl at the dot uses that PSMSL gauge: the answer with Measured by on PSMSL. Stats are over gauges only, plain counts, not weighted by area or coastline; percentiles are the lowest rate with at least that share of gauges at or below it.
